name: RimWorld mod
summary: A RimWorld mod folder: About.xml, an example Def, and an optional C# assembly with settings and Harmony.
description: The folder RimWorld loads from its Mods directory, laid out the way the game expects. The C# project builds without the game installed (it compiles against the Krafs.Rimworld.Ref package) and writes its dll straight into the versioned Assemblies folder. Turn the code off for an XML-only mod.

options.label: Copy the mod into the game after each build

next: The folder is the mod. It belongs in the Mods folder of the RimWorld install.
With code: build it with dotnet build Source -c Release (the dll lands in the versioned Assemblies folder).
Start RimWorld, open Mods, and enable the mod (and Harmony above it when the mod uses Harmony).
Turn on Development mode in Options and open the debug log to see the mod's line.
Defs are in Defs, code starts in Source\Startup.cs.
